profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading under the ticker META. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $200,966,000,000. On its developer site, the company describes building with Meta's AI models and tools, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. It says the models are tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that they perform competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also notes a quick start that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live access to the web through a single tool added to a request.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Meta Platforms, Inc. appears as a defendant in several matters: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court for the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court for the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. MCP servers for Meta Ads automation are also listed, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as having 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, along with co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp and com.adbloop/meta-ads.
